compute_stats_summary: compute min, max, mean, and median statistics for a numpy array or torch tensor
generate_correlation_summary: generate a sorted correlation summary report from a correlation matrix with row and column names
accumulate_running_values: accumulate running values by adding a new value to an existing accumulator or initializing it
track_activation_correlation: track running Pearson correlation between teacher and student activations using the StatsCorr class
get_correlation_matrix: compute the correlation matrix, teacher norms, and student norms from accumulated activation statistics
